title: Challenge: your first Terraform apply
intro: Terraform turns infrastructure into code: you declare what you want, it figures out the changes and makes them. Run the core init → plan → apply loop, then tear it down. (Commands checked; output illustrative.)

steps.instruction: Initialize the working directory (downloads providers, sets up the backend).
steps.success:
Initializing provider plugins...
- Installing hashicorp/aws v5.x...
Terraform has been successfully initialized!

steps.instruction: Preview the changes Terraform would make, never apply blind.
steps.success:
Plan: 3 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.
  + aws_vpc.main
  + aws_subnet.public
  + aws_instance.web

steps.instruction: Apply the change to create the resources (auto-approve so it doesn't prompt).
steps.success:
aws_vpc.main: Creating...
aws_instance.web: Creation complete after 22s

Apply complete! Resources: 3 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed.

steps.instruction: All done, destroy everything so it doesn't cost money.

done: Solved! init → plan → apply → destroy. The plan step is your safety check: it shows exactly what will change before anything happens. Real infrastructure, version-controlled and reproducible.
